findings.evidence: `rg`/`nl` shows `@[expose] def tensorCombine` at lines 59-62 and `@[expose] def tensorCoact` at lines 101-104; the only characteristic lemmas are `tensorCombine_tmul_tmul`, `tensorCombine_natural`, `tensorCoact_tmul`, and `tensorCoact_natural`, with no `*_def` lemma replacing body unfolding.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from both definitions and add public `tensorCombine_def`/`tensorCoact_def` restatement lemmas, plus the existing `[simp]` pure-tensor/naturality lemmas, so consumers prove against API rather than unfolding.
findings.issue: `tensorCombine` and `tensorCoact` are both public `@[expose]` definitions, but the roadmap only needs their characterized linear maps, not unfolded bodies.

summary: The new tensor coaction surface exposes implementation bodies instead of supplying opaque characteristic equations. This makes downstream code depend on the chosen shuffle/composition implementation rather than a stable API.
